summary: Keep a current, complete record of every application and software asset in use.
Assign a named owner accountable for each application or software asset.
Define and approve a policy that sets the scope and rules for managing software assets.
Define who holds each governance role and keep those assignments current.
Regularly discover installed software and reconcile it against the inventory record.
Keep records of the software licenses and entitlements the organization holds.
Compare entitlements against deployed installs to know whether the organization is over- or under-licensed.
Track license renewal and expiry dates so contracts do not lapse or overrun unnoticed.

iso19770_1: Annex A, Table A.1 (IT asset life cycle management processes)
summary: Manage each application through its full lifecycle, from initial request to eventual retirement.
Formally decommission applications and remove their data and access when they are retired.
Periodically assess the application portfolio to decide what to keep, consolidate, or eliminate.
Track software costs against budget and attribute spend to the right owners.

iso19770_1: 8.7; Annex A, Table A.1 (Relationship and contract management)
summary: Manage vendor relationships and contract terms, including the risks a supplier introduces.
Define and approve a policy setting the rules for granting and controlling system access.
Grant user access through an approved, auditable process.
Periodically review who has access to a system and confirm it is still needed.
Remove a person's access promptly when they leave or change roles.
Apply tighter controls to accounts with elevated or administrative privileges.
Separate conflicting duties so no one person can both request and approve the same action.
Retain evidence of governance activity so it can be produced for an audit.

theme: AI system risk and impact assessment before deployment
summary: Assess an AI system's risk and likely impact before it goes into production.
Maintain a record of every AI system in use, alongside the software asset inventory.
Extend vendor oversight to cover AI suppliers and the third parties they rely on.
Log identified risks in a register and track their treatment to closure.
Regularly review process performance and act on what the review finds.
Keep asset records accurate and complete enough to be trusted for decisions.

theme: Governance body, sponsor, and decision rights
summary: Establish a governance body with a named sponsor and clear decision rights.
Classify data by sensitivity and handle it according to that classification.
